segments.text: The teachings of God are very humbling to the soul that is taught. Humane knowledge puffeth up, 1 Cor. 8. 1. but the teachings of God do greatly abase the soul, Job 42. 5. I have heard of thee by the bearing of the ear, but now mine eye seeth thee; wherefore I abhor my self and repent in dust and ashes: the same light which discovers to us the holiness, justice, greatness and goodness of God, discovereth also the vileness, baseness, emptiness and total unworthiness of man: yea, of the best and holiest of men, Isa. 6. 5.
